description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order made to declare that the Excise Duty on Motor Cars and other Motor Vehicles, Auto-trishaws, Hybrid Electric Vehicles, etc. be payable w.e.f. 27.05.2016
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of excise duty rates under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989. It constitutes a regulatory change to existing legislation, specifically modifying tax rates on imported vehicles. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (new regulations, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements), not government personnel/structure changes.
